Natural warm daylight, stone courtyard, tactile cloth, skin and scales, premium painterly naturalism, subdued earthy palette. No birth scene, children, nudity, jewelry, weapons, extra limbs, glowing aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, coloured luminous mist, text or watermark. Single square image.
